places.name: Kaer Sethorn
places.text: The broken keep of House Dunmarrow. Torren's company rests here, sorts its gear and counts its coin.

places.name: Sallow Crossing
places.text: A ford village where carters, peddlers and rumours meet. The market sells gear and sigils.

places.name: Old Watchtower
places.text: A fallen border tower. Someone hid a purse in the cellar long ago.

places.name: Roadwolf Camp
places.text: Hask Gravelteeth's raiders hold the road to Eldrimar from this palisade.

places.name: Sunken Tollhouse
places.text: The old kings' tollhouse sank into the marsh after the river changed course. Its stone vault is still sealed beneath the mud.

places.name: Hollowroot Warren
places.text: A root-choked watch-post conceals a warren of old tunnels. Something has dragged iron and bones beneath the roots.

places.name: Warden's Barrow
places.text: A low mound of black stones marks the grave of a road warden. The old boundary runes are cracked, but the cairn has not been emptied.

places.name: The Greenward Gate
places.text: The old boundary arch marks the road into Orrowen Weald. Its stones bear the antler seal of House Orrowen.

places.name: The Vessmoor Causeway
places.text: A raised causeway leaves the marsh for the open Vessmoor grasslands. House Vessmoor toll-keepers still watch the mileposts.

places.name: Thornmere
places.text: The market town of Orrowen, built around a spring beneath the old thorn trees. Rangers trade news here.

places.name: Foxglove
places.text: A quiet woodland village of herbwives, bowyers and charcoal burners.

places.name: Elderbough
places.text: An old timber village guarding the northern paths of the Weald.

places.name: Cindermead
places.text: The Vessmoor market hub, where horse-breeders and river traders meet beneath the red banners.

places.name: Redwater
places.text: A river crossing town known for its ferrymen, salt beef and hard bargains.

places.name: Milefort
places.text: A fortified coaching stop built around the old royal milestone. Its garrison keeps the south road open.

places.name: The Bell Under Leaves
places.text: An abandoned bell shrine sinks into the roots. The bell rings although its clapper was buried generations ago.

places.name: Kingsroad Catacombs
places.text: Beneath the old Vessmoor milestone lies a royal ossuary, sealed when the kings abandoned the southern road.

places.name: Tidebound Envoy
places.text: A salt-stained envoy waits beside the old road marker. The Tidebound Assembly has heard that House Dunmarrow's company survived the burning estate. The envoy carries a sealed passage charter.

region_notes.orrowen: Orrowen Weald: ancient forest roads, ranger settlements and the Bell Under Leaves.
region_notes.vessmoor: Vessmoor Plains: open horse country, market towns and the Kingsroad Catacombs.
